name: Audio visual technology
summary: Get technology support for classrooms, meeting rooms and events

details.title: Classroom technology
details.html: AVSS supports installed technology in equipped classrooms. Instructors can request a brief demonstration of classroom controls before a term begins, and dedicated classroom support is available for teaching disruptions

details.title: Meetings and events
details.html: Meeting rooms and events may need microphones, projection, presentation systems, recording or on-site operators. Specialized equipment and services may carry departmental charges

details.title: Additional services
details.html: The source catalogue also includes HyFlex classrooms, digital signage, a technology lending library and classroom equipment guidance. Equipment access and eligibility depend on the location and use case
